package ap

// ddsonic's contract with go-librespot's access point, at the pinned
// version. ddsonic retires a session without ever calling Close from a
// caller, because Close can block; it relies on Done being closed first.
// See docs/ddsonic/design/spotify-token-coordinator.md, 4.3 and 14.5.

import (
	"context"
	"net"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	librespot "github.com/devgianlu/go-librespot"
	pb "github.com/devgianlu/go-librespot/proto/spotify"
)

// reconnecting is an access point whose real receive loop is inside its real
// reconnect, held at the address resolver. release lets the reconnect end.
func reconnecting(t *testing.T) (a *Accesspoint, release func()) {
	t.Helper()
	left, right := net.Pipe()
	a = DDSonicContractAP(left)
	a.welcome = &pb.APWelcome{}
	entered := make(chan struct{})
	var once sync.Once
	a.addr = func(ctx context.Context) string {
		once.Do(func() { close(entered) })
		<-ctx.Done()
		return "invalid address"
	}
	right.Close() // the receive fails, and the loop reconnects
	loopDone := make(chan struct{})
	go func() { a.recvLoop(); close(loopDone) }()
	select {
	case <-entered:
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		a.cancel()
		t.Fatal("the receive loop did not reach its reconnect")
	}
	return a, func() {
		a.cancel() // what Close does last; the tests reach in to end the cycle
		select {
		case <-loopDone:
		case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
			t.Error("the receive loop did not end")
		}
	}
}

// STOP if this fails: ddsonic's retirement depends on it. While the access
// point is reconnecting, a Close begun on another goroutine closes Done
// promptly, whatever Close itself then waits for.
func TestDDSonicContractDoneClosesBeforeCloseReturns(t *testing.T) {
	a, release := reconnecting(t)
	defer release()
	go a.Close()
	select {
	case <-a.Done():
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("Done was not closed by a Close begun during a reconnect")
	}
}

// A reviewed expectation: in that same state Close does not return until the
// reconnect ends. This is why no ddsonic caller calls it. If a later
// go-librespot makes Close prompt, this fails; ddsonic stays correct, and the
// expectation is updated in a reviewed change.
func TestDDSonicContractCloseWaitsForReconnect(t *testing.T) {
	a, release := reconnecting(t)
	closed := make(chan struct{})
	go func() { a.Close(); close(closed) }()
	<-a.Done()
	select {
	case <-closed:
		release()
		t.Fatal("EXPECTATION CHANGED: Close returned while the access point was reconnecting")
	case <-time.After(50 * time.Millisecond):
	}
	select {
	case <-a.ctx.Done():
		release()
		t.Fatal("EXPECTATION CHANGED: the reconnect's context was cancelled before Close got past the connection lock")
	default:
	}
	release()
	select {
	case <-closed:
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("Close did not return after the reconnect ended")
	}
}

// STOP if this fails: Close may be called from more than one goroutine (the
// bundle's closer, its tail, and go-librespot's own loop).
func TestDDSonicContractCloseIsOnce(t *testing.T) {
	a := NewAccesspoint(&librespot.NullLogger{}, nil, "")
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	for range 8 {
		wg.Go(a.Close)
	}
	done := make(chan struct{})
	go func() { wg.Wait(); close(done) }()
	select {
	case <-done:
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("concurrent Close calls did not all return")
	}
	select {
	case <-a.Done():
	default:
		t.Fatal("Done is open after Close")
	}
}

// A reviewed expectation: the identity getter a session builder calls waits
// for the connection lock, with no context and no look at Done. It is why a
// build ends on its own deadline and not on its builder's return.
func TestDDSonicContractIdentityGetterWaitsForReconnect(t *testing.T) {
	a := NewAccesspoint(&librespot.NullLogger{}, nil, "")
	name := "synthetic"
	a.welcome = &pb.APWelcome{CanonicalUsername: &name}
	a.connMu.Lock() // as the receive loop holds it across a reconnect
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Millisecond)
	defer cancel()
	got := make(chan string, 1)
	go func() { got <- a.Username() }()
	<-ctx.Done() // a setup deadline passes
	closed := make(chan struct{})
	go func() { a.Close(); close(closed) }()
	<-a.Done()
	select {
	case <-got:
		a.connMu.Unlock()
		t.Fatal("EXPECTATION CHANGED: the identity getter returned without the connection lock")
	case <-time.After(50 * time.Millisecond):
	}
	a.connMu.Unlock()
	for what, ch := range map[string]<-chan struct{}{"the closer": closed} {
		select {
		case <-ch:
		case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
			t.Fatalf("%s did not return", what)
		}
	}
	select {
	case <-got:
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("the getter did not return")
	}
}
